authorization.scope: exactly two branches (FREE carrier first; WAIT+C only after the free branch passes its pre-registered conditions) to t=155000; no other branch, no geometry scan, no carrier position/port change, no mid-run injection/replacement, no Q reset, no change to T047/T048 verdicts

domain.extension: ymin_new = ymin_old - 128h; original rows embedded at [128:384]; filler rows = background

query.anchor_note: IDENTITY BINDING ONLY: the anchor is the T049-measured carrier centroid so the frozen roots/transition machinery binds THE CARRIER (role letter Q is frozen bookkeeping for the carrier lineage in this stage); NO physical Q field exists in T050, no Q is injected/reset, and this tag must never be read as a physical query here or in later comparisons

original_source_note: T050 has no original T016-era source time; the carrier descends from the T009 B_c deviation and both branches start fresh at t=0 (record key kept for the frozen launch-source record)

output_port.note: registered LEFT exit for the carrier stage: complete core must pass leftward; the frozen built-in gate row of the y-era runner is superseded for T050 by the T010-leftward recomputation in analysis (aperture on y, patch_e1 direction=-1, original clean window) -- recorded, never silently mixed

measurement.shape_reference: fixed downward periodic full template at actual centroid; no fit or source subtraction
measurement.clean_output: no non-target core intersects periodic 131-square window; record mixed residual otherwise

capture.root_tags: initial source roots and Q; union over all candidate edges; rootless newborn UNKNOWN; every birth/complex core possible-related
capture.holding_population: ALL surviving full-field cores, not a chosen related subset

measurement.free_pass: exactly one unique clean standard downward Q output in fixed aperture/window, no extra propagation or pre-output periodic return

carrier_observation.question: can the pre-placed carrier C really propagate leftward in the extended domain, and how do its propagation and the device's own evolution behave with the no-Q wait structure present?  Stage-1 precondition for later Q+C -- NOT a readout success verdict
free_pass_conditions: traceable over the whole [0,155000] observation: no periodic wraparound, no unexplained complex identity changes (carrier-lineage complexes must have their frozen transition endpoint files)

leftward crossing of x=-0.25 at t<=155000 with the complete core inside the y aperture [-1.0,-0.6], window clean (original clean rule: any other core incl. newborns is an intruder) and e1<=0.25 on the T010 LEFTWARD standard reference (fixed 131x131, patch_e1 direction=-1, no fit, no source subtraction)
after the crossing: at two actual saved time points with continuous identity the carrier keeps moving left, accumulating >=0.05 physical units, without touching the periodic boundary
carrier_observation.undecidable_rule: insufficient sampling or unclear identity => UNDECIDABLE
carrier_observation.fail_rule: clearly unmet condition => FAIL; no time extension or gate change rescues a free-branch failure
carrier_observation.wait_c_conditions: record fully whether the same exit and sustained-motion conditions hold, whether C associates with sources, source states and UNKNOWN; compare with the existing T046 WAIT same-period fields/diagnostics (existing control ends at 120000; later marked MISSING); no preset pass
carrier_observation.stage_gate: WAIT+C runs only after the free branch passes; otherwise it is recorded NOT_RUN and the stage stops (Agent 1 decides any continuation)

comparison_read_only.note: existing controls are read-only; T046 WAIT ends at 120000 (beyond = MISSING); T047/T048 verdicts unchanged
